note: task-meta auto-report (docs/v0.2/DEFINITION.md section 4). Per-turn flood guard: a Stop-triggered run waits settle_seconds without new spool activity (activity => outbox SUPERSEDED_BY_ACTIVITY, the next Stop handles it); a session-end trigger publishes immediately; beyond max_revisions_per_session new data is HELD (REVISION_CAP) until a session-end trigger or auto-report --retry publishes one final revision. Kill switch: enabled=false or env TASK_META_AUTO_REPORT=0. publisher_source_sha 'auto' = git rev-parse HEAD of the task-meta install. gate_log_root: gate logs are taken by convention from <root>/<worktree>/gate*.log when the worktree name matches the session's worktree refs and the log contains GATE_SUBJECT_SHA or EXIT=.
